newsitem.title: UK: Copper mostly stable in LME evening, spread tight.
newsitem.headline: Copper mostly stable in LME evening, spread tight.

text.p: Copper prices largely remained close to final kerb levels during Wednesday evening inter-office LME trading, with activity having slowed earlier.

Traders said the market was content to hold in the range established earlier, comfortably above a succesfully-defended support level at $2,250. The cash/threes backwardation remained around a steep $180/200.
Three months copper was indicated at $2,255/60 a tonne, against Tuesday's close of $2,278. Aluminium drifted marginally lower and was quoted at $1,573/75.
